title: W6 whole-body reach closeout (development evidence only)
overall_verdict: NOT READY. Two of five agent gates failed in development; protocol status is draft; held-out not run.

gates.evaluated_on: development set only: 60 episodes (dev seeds 100-105 x heights 0.35/0.75/1.10 x 2 layouts = 36; v1 held-out seeds 5000-5023 reused as development = 24); reference label (i) feasible n=38

held_out.reason: Gates failed in development (off-band and refusal), and the protocol status is 'draft', not frozen. Freezing and running held-out after failed development gates would not be a valid gate test; the held-out seeds remain untouched. No result derived from them was read for this closeout.

dev_rerun.reason: The rollback change adds a measurement and a report field only; the slow test reproduces identical errors (24.2, 30.5, 38.1 mm) before and after it, no decision consumes rollback_ok or report.achieved, so executed behaviour on dev scenes is unchanged. results/g1_reach_heights_v2_dev_closeout_20261106 was not created.

open_defects: Correction undo does not restore state: slow test test_rollout_gate_then_monitored_real_execution_reaches_a_mid_height_target measures 24.2 mm (before), 30.5 mm (after correction), 38.1 mm (after undo reporting completed). Fails identically at 1be5130 (before the D19 commits). The test's original assertion still fails; cause of non-restoration (controller hysteresis / feed-forward state) not established.
Refusals at 19/22 and off-band feasible n=3 are below the frozen gates; n=3 is too small to be decisive either way.

can_be_attributed: Under the identical v2 evaluator, the agent reaches physical success on 31/60 episodes and the scripted baseline on 7/60 (7/38 on reference-feasible), so the v2 success definition alone does not explain the agent's result. Agent and baseline use different claim rules.

On the 41 reference-feasible scenes common to v1 and v2 the agent outcome moved from 6 successes (v1) to 29 (v2). Transitions: 9 torque-limit stops became success, 6 rollout refusals became success, 3 planner refusals became success, 3 perception/navigation failures became success; 1 success became perception/navigation failure.
Zero collapses and zero false claims under the rules actually used; 3 reference label (i)-only feasible scenes are reported separately from label (ii).
cannot_be_attributed: How much each of the simultaneous W6 changes contributed (closed-loop rollout gate, torque-aware correction, measured-torque ranking, canonical planning boxes, shoulder-torso limit, axis relaxation, dev-fitted target covariance, planner stance radii change, contact-based success, touch-plus-FK claim, strict height bounds). No ablation was run, so cause categories in attribution.json are heuristic labels, not established root causes.

Anything about generalisation: the v1 held-out seeds 5000-5023 were seen and used for development; the gates changed definition (success, claim, reference) between v1 and v2 while thresholds stayed the same; two stance-radius and height-bound changes were made after dev runs.
Any benefit of the SONIC backend: it was characterised in an envelope but the reach evaluation used backend 'wbc' only.
Odometry is oracle-assisted and perception is the classical baseline, so results are not end-to-end autonomy.
